description: Common Platform Action Data Record Header

revision.description: A 2-byte field representing a major and minor version number for the CPAD record definition.

sectionCount.description: The number of valid sections associated with the record.

urgency.description: Indicates the urgency of the action. 0 = not urgent, 1 = urgent.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the action data, 0-100%.

recordLength.description: The size of the actual CPAD record including headers, section descriptors, and section bodies.

timestamp.description: The timestamp correlates to the time when the action data was collected.

timestampIsPrecise.description: Timestamp is precise if this bit is set.

platformID.description: A GUID uniquely identifying the platform.

partitionID.description: A GUID identifying the partition on which the action applies.

creatorID.description: A GUID indicating the creator of the CPAD record.

notificationType.description: A pre-assigned GUID value indicating the record association with a notification type.

recordID.description: A value that, when combined with the Creator ID, uniquely identifies the CPAD record.
